methodologyNotes: Covers countertop home soda makers and sparkling water machines currently sold at a published US price. Includes manual (lever or press) and electric CO2-cylinder machines as well as sachet-based carbonators. Excludes commercial or under-counter carbonated-water dispensers, plumbed-in systems, single-flavor pod-syrup fridges, and CO2 cylinders sold on their own. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. co2AttachmentType is how the CO2 source connects to the machine: screw-in, quick-connect, or sachet. co2CylinderCapacityLiters is the rated liters of sparkling water per standard included CO2 cylinder, in liters; null for sachet systems that carry no reusable cylinder. bottleCapacityLiters is the usable capacity of the supplied carbonating bottle (or the water reservoir on dispensing machines), in liters. bottleMaterial is the carbonating-bottle material: pet-plastic, glass, or none. bodyMaterial is the primary housing material: stainless-steel, plastic, aluminum, or wood-composite. powered is true when the machine requires a mains electric outlet and false when it is fully manual. fizzLevelSettings is the count of preset carbonation levels the machine selects; report 1 for manual press-to-taste control. carbonatesBeyondWater is true if the maker is rated to carbonate liquids other than plain water (juice, wine, tea). builtInFlavorDosing is true if the machine automatically doses flavoring into the drink rather than requiring manual syrup addition. dishwasherSafeBottle is true if the supplied carbonating bottle is dishwasher-safe. heightInches is the machine height in inches. weightGrams is the empty machine weight in grams.
